Quality requirements — variety, FAQ grade, moisture where relevant; grade minimums on requirements
Arrival volumes — ingested, cleaned and used as RAKSHA signal layer RK-3
Transport options — district transporter directory (vehicle class, capacity, indicative tariff) attached at acceptance
Storage options — accredited warehouse lookup; e-NWR pledge-finance route (CGS-NPF) surfaced at the decision
Localised price trends — district modal, MSP floor, 7-day trend, week-of-year seasonal position
Sale-window recommendations — RAKSHA 7- and 14-day direction with band, behind the seven-condition guardrail
Match farmers and FPOs with verified buyers — explained, ranked shortlist; FPO a distinct account type; opt-in aggregation into one consignment
Lot creation — offline-capable listing with photographs, sync-state display and outbox
Quality grading — on-device vision pipeline with gates, OOD rejection, confidence bands, farmer confirmation
Digital offers — offer, counter, accept; server-authoritative; the sauda slip issued on acceptance
Logistics coordination — suggested pickup recorded on the sauda slip; pickup risk checked against weather; storage and the e-NWR route named beside a wait
Payment tracking — independent delivery confirmation; farmer payment confirmation feeding reputation
Dispute / grievance — reason-coded dispute from delivery onward, with evidence, routed to the district officer
Market persistence — lags {1,2,3,7,14,28}, EWMA spans {3,7,14}, momentum
Seasonal position — empirical week-of-year median and IQR per crop × district, leave-current-year-out
Arrival pressure — log(arrivals / WOY median arrivals), winsorised, lagged one day (same-day arrivals never a feature)
Weather pressure — rain/humidity anomaly vs district climatology × per-crop sensitivity; weather consumed, never predicted
Market shock — robust z of log returns, rolling median/MAD, 60-day window
Quantile forecast — LightGBM pinball loss τ ∈ {0.1,0.5,0.9}, log-return target, split-conformal widening, bandKappa staleness widening
Risk asymmetry (device) — carry, expected gain G, downside D, tolerable loss L from this farmer's warehouse and e-NWR rate
Evidence agreement — skill-weighted vote over UP/FLAT/DOWN with measured weights shipped in the bundle; unanimous calm is confident calm
Decision guardrail (device) — seven-condition conjunction GR-1…GR-7
Price data fresh within the crop's staleness limit — refusal: Not enough current data to advise you.
Model has beaten its naive baseline for this crop — refusal: The forecast does not beat the normal seasonal baseline.
Forecast confidence clears the higher of the two thresholds — refusal: The evidence is not strong enough to suggest waiting.
Evidence agreement across layers is sufficient — refusal: The signals do not agree strongly enough.
Seasonal position does not strongly contradict the signal — refusal: The season points the other way.
Expected gain net of storage, spoilage and financing clears its cost — refusal: Expected upside does not cover storage and spoilage costs.
A real, named storage mechanism is within reach of this farmer — refusal: Waiting may not be practical for this lot.

All frames fail the gates — no grade; keep the best frame; say what was wrong

Orientation and EXIF — apply orientation, then strip all EXIF including GPS by redrawing to canvas before upload

Stop silently converting quintal→kg at parse time; carry {value, unit} end to end and echo the farmer's own unit

No arbitrary fallback location (parseCropMessage fallbackLocation, CITIES[]); district comes from the verified registry record
Crop is a hard filter with one auditable substitution table — no +5 mismatch or +25 substring partial credit
Price scored against the district benchmark, never against the farmer's own ask (buy.price / sell.price)
Remove all security signalling from the farmer UI (Runs locally, shield, Demo build, Verified chips)
Contact and phone move out of buyer/listing rows into separate contact tables; disclosure only after offer + farmer acknowledgement; audited; rate-limited
Invert verification: buyer gated by GSTIN/Udyam before offering or receiving contacts; farmer check establishes identity and district, not a barrier
Remove the browser Groq API key input and its localStorage copy; model fallback is server-side behind ModelFallbackAdapter
Replace localStorage-as-database and innerHTML string rendering with Dexie/IndexedDB + outbox, PostgreSQL + RLS and React components
Replace the render-blocking Google Fonts @import with self-hosted, subset, preloaded fonts using font-display: swap
@fasal/shared is pure — zero runtime dependencies, no I/O, no clock or randomness, no framework imports (Constitution §3, PROMPT §VI)
Logs never carry personal data — a seeded phone number and registry, GSTIN, Udyam and email identifiers are redacted from the log stream (PROMPT §8.5)

The API connects as a NOSUPERUSER, NOBYPASSRLS, non-owner role and refuses to start otherwise; request context is set per transaction with SET LOCAL semantics and never leaks through the pool (PROMPT §8.1)
Configuration is parsed with zod at boot; no secret has a default; only .env.example is committed (PROMPT §8.5)
Migrations are ordered, checksummed, idempotent and immutable once applied (PROMPT §3.2)

Every external dependency sits behind an adapter with Mock and Live implementations passing one contract suite; switching is .env, never code; a live adapter without credentials stops the server (PROMPT §3.4, Constitution §15)
